_source: Feat loop b5, lane b5-spells (2026-11-26): the activated feats of the spell-hook and modifier batch. Each is had by a holder of the feat its `feat` names (rules/class_abilities.py), run by the one executor (`Engine._use_class_ability`), and each spends its declared action from the turn's budget. Benefit text from content/feats/feats.json, checked against aonprd.com FeatDisplay 2026-11-26.
_grammar: rules/class_abilities.py, module docstring. The engine reads these fields and never these names.

abilities.name: Improved Back to Back
abilities.source: Improved Back to Back (UC): 'While you are adjacent to an ally who is flanked and also has this feat, you can spend a swift action to gain a +2 bonus to AC against all flankers until the start of your next turn.' The ally is asked on the board (`feat_events.ally_holds`, `flanked` and `feat`); the bonus (the feat document's, asked on the AC line with the board's flank) answers an attacker who flanks the bearer (owner call: the flankers are the ones flanking you).
abilities.text: Swift action, beside a flanked ally with this feat: +2 AC against flankers until your next turn.
abilities.tell: {name} sets a shoulder to an ally's and turns to face the ones closing in.

abilities.name: Slow Time
abilities.source: Slow Time (F&P): 'Once per day, when you meditate as a full-round action using the Combat Meditation feat, you gain the effects of haste for 1 round per 2 character levels. These effects do not stack with the haste spell, the speed magic weapon special ability, or other effects granting the same result. This is an extraordinary ability.' The haste spell's own numbers (content/spells: +1 attack, +1 dodge AC and Reflex, +30 ft, one more attack in a full attack) with the meditation's tags, for 1 round per 2 levels.
abilities.text: Once a day, full round: combat meditation with haste, 1 round per 2 levels.
abilities.tell: {name} breathes out, and the fight around them slows to a crawl.
not_yet: the combat meditation's own use: Slow Time is spent from its once-a-day pool, not from Combat Meditation's Wisdom-times-a-day, and the meditation benefits it lays last its 1 round per 2 levels, not the 1 round per level of a combat meditation
not stacking with the haste spell or a speed weapon: a haste buff carries no tag to refuse it by, so the attack and dodge terms would stack
